verdict.rationale: Autumn ships an official SDK (JS/TS) demonstrated via autumn.check/autumn.track calls, a full API reference (attach, track, previewAttach, multiAttach, createSchedule, etc.), a CLI (atmn) for config-as-code, and a native AI SDK integration for automatic token tracking in generateText/streamText calls—clearly enabling AI-native developers to build directly against official tooling. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond JS/TS (e.g., Python/Go), independent third-party corroboration of SDK reliability, and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s).
